process_scope.worker_heap: All dynamic Python/native heap attributable to the I122 worker: original fixtures/retained originals, observer and runtime, every11 owner. Opaque means not cloned, not memory-free.
process_scope.coordinator_heap: Separate process allocation account; not charged to the11/12GiB worker budget and not omitted from end-to-end timing.
process_scope.child_process_heaps: Separate per-process allocation/service accounts if claiming joint-host capacity; original child work is not reclassified as instrumented parent events.
process_scope.joint_host_capacity: No aggregate RAM/RSS/capacity claim. P02/P03 and later proofs must identify all relevant processes/assumptions.
process_scope.timing_process_scope: Coordinator, worker and children/service relevant to launch-entry..normal-return; all C01-C10 interval contributors including worker work before tR.
process_scope.failure_scope: Heap proof must cover bounded observer-rejection prefixes and retained tracebacks within the fixed original-source scope. The900 success target is not a guarantee that all failure cleanup paths complete within900.

source_semantics_limits: Worker command uses coordinator sys.executable with -B and a fixed module; Popen receives the explicit environment in the pinned AST. This is a source expectation, not proof of selected executable contents, loader/native dependencies, startup configuration or target image.

The public logical command python3 is normalized. The base invocation path_sha256 hashes os.fsencode(sys.executable), a path string, not binary bytes; it cannot replace I127 file hash or target binary attestation.

The two pinned original support modules declare multiprocessing spawn contexts. This does not constitute a complete child/process inventory or prove their selected runtimes; original tests/CLI/native descendants and relevant service still need a complete mapping.

AST import syntax includes nested/unreachable branches; dynamic arguments can remain unresolved. No module execution, find_spec, loader, recursive stdlib/native discovery or frozen/builtin completeness follows.
